title: Whiteout draws opaque box without stripping underlying text stream (False Redaction)
expected: Confidential text "000-12-3456" must be removed from the PDF content stream
actual: Underlying text "000-12-3456" is still 100% extractable from the PDF
details: Text extracted by pdf.js: "Invoice #1001 - PaperFlow Corp  Original Price: $29.00 USD due August 14, 2026  Confidential Client Information: SSN 000-12-3456"

title: In-place text replacement leaves original text in PDF stream under white rectangle
expected: Original text is replaced in content stream and cannot be extracted
actual: Both original text ("$29.00 USD") AND new text ("$99.00 USD") exist simultaneously in stream

title: Non-Latin Unicode characters (Hindi/Devanagari) throw error with StandardFonts.Helvetica
expected: Text "नमस्ते भारत" successfully encoded and exported in PDF
actual: Throws WinAnsi encoding failure: "WinAnsi cannot encode "न" (0x0928)"

title: Non-Latin Unicode characters (Arabic) throw error with StandardFonts.Helvetica
expected: Text "مرحبا بكم" successfully encoded and exported in PDF
actual: Throws WinAnsi encoding failure: "WinAnsi cannot encode "م" (0x0645)"

title: Non-Latin Unicode characters (Emoji) throw error with StandardFonts.Helvetica
expected: Text "Document Approved 🚀✨" successfully encoded and exported in PDF
actual: Throws WinAnsi encoding failure: "WinAnsi cannot encode "" (0x1f680)"

title: SVG images advertised in UI tooltip fail to export and are silently dropped
expected: SVG image is converted and embedded into exported PDF
actual: pdfDoc.embedJpg throws "SOI not found in JPEG" and drops image entirely
details: embedJpg rejection: SOI not found in JPEG

title: Rotated drawing annotations ignore rotation angle and export unrotated at 0 degrees
expected: Draw element stroke points are rotated around center point by el.rotation
actual: renderDraw does not compute rotated coordinates or apply rotation to line segments
details: renderDraw source lines 517-531 lack rotation coordinate transformation

title: Link tool allows unsafe URI scheme "javascript:" without allowlist
expected: Reject unsafe URI schemes; only allow http:, https:, mailto:

title: Link tool allows unsafe URI scheme "file:" without allowlist
expected: Reject unsafe URI schemes; only allow http:, https:, mailto:

title: Link tool allows unsafe URI scheme "data:" without allowlist
expected: Reject unsafe URI schemes; only allow http:, https:, mailto:

title: Deleting a page desynchronizes pageIndex for elements on subsequent pages, orphaning them
expected: Elements on pages > deletedPageIndex must have their pageIndex decremented by 1
actual: Element on former page 2 still has pageIndex: 2 (exceeding document max index 1) and is lost
